architecture: **Canonical write paths**: `version-truth-catalog.md` (truth placement); `project-version-governance.md` (branch); per-feature truth remains `features/<slug>/truth.md` inside each version tree.
**Modules**: extend `archive_governance.py` + new catalog parser; truth-map / doctor / versioning read catalog before scanning dirs.
business_flow: Operator triggers cutover or audit need.
`archive catalog plan` diffs active window vs disk layout.
`catalog apply --confirm` commits MD + relocates trees + regenerates projections.
Inspect commands use catalog to resolve `truth_root` for active or archive path.
decision_priority: MD catalog truth_root wins over directory glob discovery.
Explicit `--version` wins for inspect; delivery commands fail-closed on non-active unless `--include-archived`.
Feature `truth.md` wins over prd for discovery on v1.5.2+.
Governance MD never holds feature requirement content.
